title: 第11章 衔光镜砂，查验宝册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天仓府乃是鉴天教诸般灵物的储藏、发放之地。

凡是奖赏，多来此府。

和抡才府一般，天仓府也在云海之上，需得炼炁之上的修士才可进入。

好在已经难不倒如今的陆玄了。

他云炁化光，没花多久，就在一座金砖玉瓦的巍峨大殿前停了下来。

殿内正在忙碌的胎息值守当即迎了出来，恭敬地喊道：

“见过师兄！”

“不知师兄到访天仓府，有何贵干？”

陆玄此时已经换上了内门弟子的金碟玉符，故此殿中值守一眼就认出了他的身份。

只是心中有些好奇，此前似乎从未见过陆玄。

“我依教规，前来领取开窍之灵物。”

陆玄没有废话，开门见山，同时将自己的玉符递给了值守。

玉符之中，自有他的信息，凭之可领灵物。

“还请师兄稍待，我来核验一番。”

值守恭敬地接过玉符，领着陆玄进入殿中，随后取出天仓宝册，开始核验。

不多时，值守脸上就露出了笑意：“原来是二次大醮得成的陆师兄，依教规，却有一件开意根之灵物赐下，还请师兄稍待，我去取来。”

言罢，他准备转身，进入府库。

陆玄心中稍松，于殿中等待。

不多时，那值守就捧着一枚玉瓶归来：“师兄，灵物就在盒中，还请师兄核验无误后，于宝册之上签名即可。”

陆玄颔首，随即接过玉瓶，可只是扫了一眼，他眉头就微微一皱。

只见玉瓶封签之上，是四个淡金的大字：“衔光镜砂！”

陆玄抬首，对着那值守问道：“此砂品秩为何等？”

值守不敢隐瞒，恭敬地答道：“此砂可衔光，凝灵镜，乃是甲等下品之灵物。”

甲等下品！

陆玄在蛰院九载，读过不知多少道经，虽然对参、证、斋三醮知之不详，但寻常隐秘，灵物品秩还是了解的。

各境之灵物，有五等，分别为甲乙丙丁，甲等之上，尚有先天之神物，但神物可遇不可求，故此一般而言，不算在四等之中。

而在四等之中，又分上中下，上品最妙，中品次之，下品稍差两筹。

能入甲等者，自是非凡，但下品之物，终究是比不上中品。

毫厘之差，在往后的修行之中，或许根本看不到变化，但又或许，至关重要。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Tiancang Mansion is the place where all kinds of spiritual objects of Jiantian Sect are stored and distributed.

For all rewards, come here more often.

Like Luancai Mansion, Tiancang Mansion is also above the sea of ​​clouds, and only monks who are above Qi Refining can enter.

Fortunately, it is no longer difficult for Lu Xuan now.

His cloud light turned into light, and it didn't take long before he stopped in front of a majestic palace made of gold bricks and jade tiles.

The fetal breath guard who was busy in the hall immediately came out and shouted respectfully:

"I've met senior brother!"

"I wonder what your senior brother is doing when he comes to Tiancang Mansion?"

Lu Xuan had already put on the inner disciple's gold plate and jade talisman, so the guards in the palace recognized his identity at a glance.

I was just a little curious, as I had never seen Lu Xuan before.

"I am here to receive the enlightenment spiritual object according to the religious rules."

Lu Xuan didn't talk nonsense and got straight to the point. At the same time, he handed his jade talisman to the guard.

The jade talisman contains his information, which can be used to receive spiritual objects.

"Please wait a moment, senior brother, while I come to check."

The guard respectfully took the jade talisman, led Lu Xuan into the palace, then took out the Tiancang treasure book and began to verify it.

Not long after, a smile appeared on the guard's face: "It turns out that Senior Brother Lu, who was successful in the second big ceremony, was given a spiritual object that opens the root of meaning according to the religious rules. Please wait a moment, Senior Brother, while I go get it."

After saying this, he was about to turn around and enter the treasury.

Lu Xuan felt a little relieved and waited in the hall.

Not long after, the guard returned holding a jade bottle: "Senior brother, the spiritual object is in the box. Please verify that it is correct and then sign the treasure book."

Lu Xuan nodded and immediately took the jade bottle, but after just a glance, he frowned slightly.

On the seal of the jade bottle, there are four large characters in light gold: "Hand the light mirror sand!"

Lu Xuan raised his head and asked the guard: "What is the grade of this sand?"

The guard did not dare to hide it, and replied respectfully: "This sand can hold light, and the spirit-condensing mirror is a low-grade spiritual object."

First-class inferior product!

Lu Xuan has been in Zheyuan for nine years and has read countless Taoist scriptures. Although he does not know much about the three rituals of Shen, Zheng and Zhai, he still understands the ordinary secrets and the order of spiritual objects.

There are five levels of spiritual objects in each realm, namely A, B, C and D. Above level A, there are still innate divine objects, but the divine objects can be encountered but not sought, so generally speaking, they are not included in the fourth grade.

Among the four grades, they are divided into upper, middle and lower grades. The top grade is the best, the middle grade is second, and the low grade is slightly worse.

Those who can reach the first grade are naturally extraordinary, but low-grade things will not be as good as mid-grade things after all.

A slight difference may not change at all in future practice, but it may be crucial.
